acceptance.basis: Literal original coordinates across fields/values and generated source/offset/mixed parity; 312 complete searches, 7488 selected-document comparisons, 3558 original slices. Successful Boolean ancestors and complete overlapping phrase participation are independently evaluated.

Source/offset/mixed outputs agree against independently constructed raw/normalized lexeme pairs, including normalization length changes and supplementary letters; independent expected behavior never calls production tokenizer/compiler/evaluator/scorer.

1260 exact grapheme-safe snippet windows and 3744 independent omission-count reconstructions; exact source slices, relative marks, window/highlight caps and omission flags checked. Focused tests additionally cover overlong token/grapheme unavailable counts.
Output stays ordinary readonly plain data. Unsafe literal source is returned only as exact text; source and documented rendering contract contain no HTML producer or unsafe DOM insertion.

Missing source, missing offsets, positions-only range claims, missing selected roots/fields, stale revisions and six malformed/missing Segmenter hosts fail explicitly, including empty selections/queries. Ordinary and range-only requests need no Segmenter.

7 cancellation outcomes, 1 deadline, 1 disposal, 13 recoveries, 5 selected projection stops, 1 real native segmentation iterator closure and 6 FIFO ownership operations. Complete range/fact/output caps reject whole output; shared registration and global operation budgets are independently measured. Graph/startup/source hashes confirm optional imports, no new side-root participant or runtime dependency.
